units.source_text: 我在心里把父亲和先生作了一番比较。

en.t: In my heart, I made a comparison between my father and Sensei.

units.source_text: 从社会存在的角度来看，两个人都是无足轻重的老实人；

en.t: Viewed in terms of their existence in society, both men were insignificant, honest people;

units.source_text: 从受人关注这一点来说，他们也都等于零。

en.t: and in terms of receiving attention from others, they both amounted to nothing.

units.source_text: 然而，我这位喜欢下将棋的父亲，即便仅仅作为消遣的伙伴，也不能够使我获得满足；

en.t: Yet my father, who liked playing shogi, could not satisfy me even merely as a companion for amusement;

units.source_text: 而从未一起游乐过的先生，竟不知不觉地给我的头脑带来了那种超越世俗亲密关系的影响。

en.t: while Sensei, with whom I had never once gone out for pleasure, had somehow come to influence my mind in a way that went beyond ordinary worldly intimacy.

units.source_text: 只是“头脑”这个词有些冰冷，应该说成是“心”。

en.t: Only, the word mind sounds somewhat cold; I should call it my heart.

units.source_text: 即便说，先生的力量渗进了我的肉体，先生的生命流入了我的血液，对于那时的我来说，也毫不夸张。

en.t: Even to say that Sensei's strength had seeped into my flesh, and that Sensei's life had flowed into my blood, would not have seemed the least bit exaggerated to me then.

units.source_text: 父亲是我的生身之父，先生当然是个外人，这显而易见的事实摆在眼前时，我仿佛发现一个了不起的真理一般，不禁愕然了。

en.t: When I set before myself the obvious fact that my father was my own father by birth and that Sensei was of course an outsider, I was stunned, as though I had discovered some tremendous truth.
